texts.facts: The present Criminal Miscellaneous Petition has been filed by the Petitioner under Section 482 B.N.S.S. for anticipatory bail in connection with N.D.P.S. Case No. 61 of 2024 in the Court of learned Sessions Judge, Katihar arising out of Town Katihar (Sahayak) P.S. Case No. 659 of 2024, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 21(c), 22(c) and 25 of the N.D.P.S., Act, 1985 against the Petitioner and co-accused, Mahboob Alam. The prosecution case as emerging from the written report of Assistant Officer Incharge of Sahayak Police Station, Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.32593 of 2025 dt.09-09-2025 2/32 Katihar is that on 09.09.2024, the Informant/Police Officer got secret information at about 10:05 O'clock that the co-accused, Mahboob Alam @ Lal Khan is selling codeine syrup and intoxicant medicine and he has concealed such contraband in the house of Arman Ansari and also in the bush nearby his house. He sells that contraband after taking out from that place of storage. Hence, Sanha No. 246 of 2024 was lodged on 09.09.2024 and the Superintendent of Police was accordingly informed by Memo No. 2102 of 2024 dated 09.09.2024 for further proceeding and constituting a team. Hence, after getting instruction from the superior officers, the Informant along with other police officers proceeded to the place of storage of the contraband and when the team reached near the house of the Petitioner, one person came out of the house and seeing the police, he started fleeing away. The house of the Petitioner was searched and two bags were recovered, one bag was containing 400 bottles of cough syrup of 100 ml. each and as per description on the bottle, the cough syrup contains "Codeine Phosphate & Triprolidine Hydrocloride Syrup WISCOF DX" containing codeine. The other bag was containing 300 Nitracross Tablets. Further four containers were also recovered from his house containing 850 Nitracross Tablets. When the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.32593 of 2025 dt.09-09-2025 police further proceeded to the place of bansfiti, one person was seen to be fleeing away from the bush and after search of the bush, three bags were recovered and every bag was containing 200 bottles of cough syrup of 100 ml. each containing "Codeine Phosphate & Triprolidine Hydrocloride Syrup WISCOF DX" and one bag was containing 1440 Pyeevon Spas Plus Tablet.
